name: HCL Technologies Ltd.
business_summary: Third/fourth-largest Indian IT company: IT & business services, engineering and R&D services (ER&D) and HCLSoftware (products). Americas ~65%, Europe ~30%. TTM sales ~Rs1.35 lakh cr, EBITDA ~21%, net cash, ROE 24%, yield 3.8%. Q2 FY27 (2026-10-12): revenue Rs35,620 cr, PAT Rs5,132 cr (+11% QoQ), advanced AI revenue +78%, FY27 CC revenue guide raised/narrowed to 2.5-4%, margin guide retained; shares jumped up to 8% intraday, +19% in a month.

exposures.mechanism: ~95% revenue foreign currency, INR ~ 45% of costs (model knowledge). Company has cited ~25-30bp margin per 1% INR: +3% => ~+85bp on 21% = +4% EBITDA, persistence 0.4, EV/MCap 0.97 => +1.6. Pack -2.75 (t -1.8) negative, insignificant.

exposures.mechanism: Americas ~65% of revenue; +1pp US growth => revenue +0.95%, incremental margin 30% vs 21% => EBITDA +1.4%; with re-rating persistence 1.0 => ~+2.8.
